description: Arpeggiator that plays the pitches arriving on one polyphonic cable in a chosen order, one note per clock

params.text: Chooses the order the input pitches are played in: Straight-R, Straight-L, Straight-RL, Straight-LR, Crab-R, Crab-L, Crab-RL or Crab-LR, and the chosen name is shown on the display
Sets how many steps into the arpeggio playing starts, 0 to 10, wrapped round to the length of the arpeggio

inputs.text: A rising edge moves the arpeggio on to its next note, and the module plays nothing until something is patched here
The polyphonic cable of 1V/octave pitches the arpeggio is built from, read afresh at the start of each pass; with nothing patched a single 0V pitch is used
A polyphonic gate cable choosing which channels of the V/OCT input are played: only channels at a positive voltage are used, and with nothing patched here every channel is used
A voltage here chooses the order the pitches are played in, in place of the ARPEGGIO knob; whole volts from 0V to 7V pick the eight orders
A positive voltage holds the arpeggio as it is and blocks changes to the order, while randomisation triggers are accepted; a negative voltage blocks randomisation as well
A trigger swaps two notes of the running arpeggio with each other, either of which may already have been played

outputs.text: The 1V/octave pitch of the note being played, clamped to -10V to 10V
Carries 10V on each note of the arpeggio, as a 1ms trigger, a retrigger or a continuous gate according to the menu
A 1ms trigger on the clock edge that follows the last note of the arpeggio

notes: the module has no clock of its own, so nothing plays until a clock is patched into CLOCK.
menu: Gate Mode — what the GATE output carries: Trigger, a 1ms trigger on each note; Retrigger, a gate dropping low for 1ms between notes; Continuous, a gate held high while the arpeggio runs
Play last note in cyclical arpeggios — Play last note sounds the note at the turn of a Straight-RL or Straight-LR arpeggio twice; Omit last note leaves that repeat out

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.5: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
